prompt: Review a new server/src/modules/notifications/ module (routes.ts, service.ts, repository.ts, helpers.ts) for architecture / layering problems before opening a PR.

assertions.text: Flags routes.ts querying the DB directly (db.select/db.update) — route-no-direct-db
Flags service.ts new-ing a concrete OctokitGitHubClient instead of using container.github() interface
Flags service.ts importing drizzle-orm / querying the DB directly in countUnread — service-no-direct-db
Flags service.ts importing the sibling agents/repository.js — no-cross-module-internals (use container.agentsRepo)
Flags repository.ts importing from adapters/ (renderMarkdown) — repository-no-adapters
Flags repository.ts deleteById missing the workspaceId predicate (cross-tenant / tenancy guard)
Does NOT falsely flag the legitimate db/rows row-type imports or the pure helpers.ts
